page.layout: One printed page, one column of text; running head at the top with page number at top right. No margin notes. Lines of the column end with a catchword-like signature mark at the bottom right.

main_text.p: script. Canonicorum, heroico carmine, ubi devenit ad scripta Paulina,
Bis septena pij quod spargit Epistola Pauli.

XXXII. Vigilius Episcopus Tridentinus, Gelasio, Fulgentio, Avito contemporaneus, sub Anastasio Imperatore. L. II. Contrà Eutychem, adducit locum Hebr. 11.7. Fecisti eum modicum minorem Angelis, his verbis; Paulo ita ad Hebræos loquente. Alibi Disputat. de Christo & Trinitate, Paulus Apostolus de Filio ad Hebræos scribens Hebr. 1.3. Aliis sæpe locis idem.

XXXIII. Facundus Afer, Hermianensis Episcopus, clarus sub Iustiniano Imperatore: Pro defens. trium Capitul. ex editione Sirmundi, Lib. xii. C. 1. Et ideò cum audiamus Apostolum, inter alios iustos Samson quoque laudantem, atque dicentem &c. Hebr. xi. 32. Ibidem Cap. iii. sic etiam cum Paulus, Petri coapostolus, Christianis omnibus legitur dicens, Obedite præpositis vestris &c. Hebr. xiii. 17.

page.notes: Scan is blurred; the signature mark at the foot right is partly illegible and was read as a gathering mark, uncertain. Some words in the top lines (ⅽⅽ region) and the last line are low-confidence. The first line word "script." is a fragment of "scripts" cut at the left edge; the word at line start "scripţ" may read "scripi" in the original. Ligature-like spacing in "Hebr.xiii.17" and "Cap. iii." is as seen. Page number read as "123" from the top right, slightly uncertain.
